name: opening
title: Your roof. Your energy. Your decision.
lines: Before investing in solar, one decision connects many questions.
Is the roof suitable? What could it generate? And how might that investment perform?
Signix brings those questions into one rooftop planning workspace.

name: home
title: 01  /  Start with the roof
lines: Begin with a dedicated Home planning experience, using the location and electricity inputs for your scenario.

name: mapping
title: 02  /  Map real constraints
lines: The satellite map provides visual context. Draw a planning boundary, then mark the areas you want to exclude.
Here, a demonstration footprint and obstruction show how usable area changes before sizing begins.
This is an illustrative planning exercise, not a survey of this building.

name: planner
title: 03  /  Explore the layout
lines: The rooftop designer connects the footprint to a panel layout preview.
Switch between views and inspect the arrangement. Prototype geometry and unverified shade remain clearly identified.

name: energy
title: 04  /  Understand energy potential
lines: Generation forecasts turn the selected system into monthly and long term energy estimates.
The application exposes its data source and planning assumptions.
This demonstration uses mock weather fallback. These figures illustrate the calculation workflow, rather than verified site production.

name: finance
title: 05  /  Examine the investment
lines: For a home, review the estimated investment, household savings, and payback alongside the assumptions behind them.
Any residential assistance is indicative and subject to eligibility and official verification.
A planning estimate is never a guarantee of savings.

name: business
title: 06  /  A distinct Business workflow
lines: Business planning uses its own commercial policies while sharing the rooftop and energy workflow.
Review capital cost, the annual operations and maintenance reserve, net operating benefit, return on investment, and payback.
Residential subsidy is not a commercial benefit. Demand charge savings are not modelled.

name: compare
title: 07  /  Compare before committing
lines: Save a configuration, change one planning choice, and compare the resulting scenarios for the same roof.
The side by side view makes differences in capacity, investment, and expected performance easier to discuss.
The calculation engine supplies the results shown here.

name: pdf
title: 08  /  Take the discussion further
lines: Export the planning summary for a conversation with an installer or project partner.
Keep the assumptions and limitations with the figures, so the next decision starts with the same context.

name: bilingual
title: 09  /  Planning in two languages
lines: The same report can be explored in English and Hindi, helping more people participate in the decision.

name: closing
title: Make the solar decision clearer.
lines: Map the roof. Understand the energy potential. Compare the investment.
Signix. Rooftop Solar Planning.
Use the estimate to ask better questions, then verify the site, design, and approvals before procurement.
